How `UNIFORM_FRACTION` was recovered: Claude transcript `~/.claude/projects/-home-manosgior-Documents-GitHub-oraqle-ics/94019386-7e9a-4302-8276-39a280e43d5e.jsonl`, line 1039 (2026-10-26T11:57Z). It is an inline `stim` run from the oraqle-ics checkout with `../MCMit/.venv/bin/python`, which printed exactly the five constants. `system/derive_uniform_fraction.py` re-runs it, and all values plus the five d=9 timing fractions match to 4 decimals.

How the CXL-Quantum Helios numbers were traced: CXL-Quantum `plots/fig_budget.py:14-16` names qShell `figure8_ler.json` as the source of the 308/184 ns "decode stage, without request/response serialization". Commit 3307a11 (2026-10-07) introduced the 772 ns Micro Blossom and 1.51 µs Helios rows. No record of the Micro Blossom bench was found.
